title: Incredible to see blue wave: Mamdani on Democrats' sweeping midterm polls
description:
New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Wednesday said that the results of the mid-term elections are a "referendum" on politicians telling working people that their needs were unrealistic, and it was "incredible" to see the sweeping victories registered by Democrats in the House and Senate.
"It was incredible to see the blue wave," Mamdani said at a press conference.
He was referring to the sweeping wins across the country registered by the Democratic Party in Tuesday's mid-term elections that have given them control of the House and Senate and delivered a stunning rebuke to President Donald Trump and the policies of the Republican Party.
Mamdani said the result was a referendum on politics at large across America.
"This referendum was on politicians telling working people that their needs were unrealistic, while those same politicians were willing to do whatever it is that the wealthiest people in the country would ask them to do. And I think this election is also a referendum on .
